_source: frozen evaluation artifacts under data/ (no retraining, no re-scoring); see module docstring

protocol.held: excluded from training and evaluation (genuine measurements only)
protocol.significance: shot-clustered paired bootstrap, 10,000 resamples, 95% CI excludes 0 (PR4)
protocol.backbone: seq_v2 (full-grid causal LSTM, V_rot branch blocked from the fast diagnostics)
protocol.window_control: iter009 GRU + observation-masked attention at W = 2 (held-free; cut / no-cut per population)

definitions.block: observed rows in time order, split at gaps >= 0.5 s
definitions.ti_run: maximal run of consecutive observed CES_TI > 3000 eV
definitions.ti_isolated: single-row run with both observed neighbours < 2000 eV
definitions.vt_jump: |v - mean(prev, next)| with both neighbours inside +-300

gate.claim2_verdict: restate claim 2 (causal GP not beaten 4/4) and add 'beat causal GP' to the B.2 objective

verdict.note: no width < 160 loses significantly on >= 3/4 splits: the curve is flat down to the smallest width measured

protocol.hist0_note: history-0 point = CES_ABLATE=no_history at W=4 (dataset requires window_size >= 2)
protocol.data_treatment: held-free: CES_DROP_STUCK_TARGETS=1 at train AND eval

window_sweep_held_free.note: held-free, cap 500, no spike cut (the frozen W = 2 point of this sweep is the inclusive-population window control)

_design.cal: val split of the same run

_design.strata: dt bin (15/25/45 ms) x input-only activity flag
_design.target_distribution: genuinely-missing rows in-domain (mis_dom); coverage = mass of surviving strata

latency.scope: network forward pass only; feature assembly and normalization happen outside the model and are not included
